keyform_data.description: Little endian f32. Cell offset counts floats, not bytes. Each cell has 2*vertexCount floats. With parent_absolute geometry encoding, keyforms are absolute normalized parent-space positions; legacy encoding uses canvas rest plus normalized delta. CMO adapter converts to editor rest-relative positions.

glues.description: Native source-identity seam constraints, master weight zero / copy weight one.

visibility.description: Native inverse foreground masks and semantic stable eye layering; no runtime depth buffer.
